page.title: Requisition plans
page.description: Gather a work site's approved requests into a single list, launch the plan and share the link so suppliers can quote on it.

kpi.title: Plan indicators
kpi.availableHint: Approved, outside any plan and without an open quotation
kpi.launchedHint: Launched plans with an open quotation

error.title: Could not load the plans
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No plans here
empty.description: Create a plan by gathering a work site's approved requests.

pdf.title: Request for quotation — plan #{{numero}}
pdf.howToLink: Open the address below, enter your company's CNPJ and fill in the unit price, brand and reference for each item by {{prazo}}. Companies not yet registered can register on the same page.
pdf.howToNoLink: Send your proposal to the purchasing team by {{prazo}}, with unit price, brand and reference for each item.
pdf.privacy: Prices are seen only by the purchasing team — other suppliers have no access.

form.description: Pick the approved requests (usually from one work site). Identical items are added up into a single line.

hints.workSite: Shown to suppliers in the link and in the PDF.
hints.notes: Delivery address, terms, deadlines… Suppliers see this text.

errors.deadline: Choose a date from today onwards.

form.filter: Filter by title, work site or requester
form.noCandidatesDescription: Only approved requests (in purchasing or being quoted) that are not in another plan and have no open quotation can be added.
form.previewEmpty: Pick requests to see the list suppliers will quote.
form.previewHint: {{lines}} request lines became {{items}} items: same product, unit, brand and reference are added up.

launch.title: Launch plan #{{numero}}
launch.description: Opens the quotation with {{items}} items from {{requests}} requests and turns on the open link, with a deadline of {{prazo}}. Once launched, the plan can no longer be edited.
launch.inviteHint: Chosen suppliers get their own answer link. Others can join through the open link with their CNPJ.

detail.draftHint: Draft: check the list and launch the plan to open the quotation and create the link suppliers use to quote.
detail.cancelDescription: The requests become available again for another plan or quotation.
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed or the address is wrong.

toast.launched: Plan #{{numero}} launched — quotation open and link active.
